rules.title: Rules
rules.text: Draw cards from the stock onto the waste pile one at a time. On the tableau, build downwards in alternating colours; only a king may go on an empty column. Build the four foundations at the top right by suit from ace to king. Tap a card, then its destination; tap the same card again and it goes to its foundation or to the first column that takes it. Scoring: waste to tableau +5, card to a foundation +10, turning a card over +5, foundation to tableau −15. Keyboard: arrow keys select, Enter or Space picks up and puts down, F sends to a foundation, D draws a card, Z undoes.
